mapper.select: select tenant_id, request_id, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dry_run, launch_payload::text from batch.workflow_launch_wait where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = 'WAITING' for update
mapper.insert:
with incoming as (select #{launchPayload}::jsonb as payload) insert into batch.workflow_launch_wait ( tenant_id, request_id, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dry_run, launch_payload) select #{tenantId}, #{requestId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{bizDate}, #{dryRun}, incoming.payload from batch.trigger_request request cross join incoming where request.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request.request_id = #{requestId} and request.workflow_definition_id = #{workflowDefinitionId} and request.biz_date = #{bizDate} and request.dry_run = #{dryRun} and request.request_status in ('ACCEPTED', 'PROCESSING') and jsonb_typeof(incoming.payload) = 'object' and incoming.payload ->> 'format' = 'WORKFLOW_CAPACITY_WAIT_V1' and jsonb_typeof(incoming.payload -> 'sealedSnapshotPayload') = 'string' and length(incoming.payload ->> 'sealedSnapshotPayload') > 0 and incoming.payload ->> 'tenantId' = request.tenant_id and incoming.payload ->> 'requestId' = request.request_id and incoming.payload ->> 'workflowDefinitionId' = request.workflow_definition_id::text and incoming.payload ->> 'jobCode' is null
and incoming.payload -> 'bizDate' = jsonb_build_array( extract(year from request.biz_date)::int, extract(month from request.biz_date)::int, extract(day from request.biz_date)::int) and coalesce(incoming.payload ->> 'dryRun', 'false') = case when request.dry_run then 'true' else 'false' end for share of request on conflict (tenant_id, request_id) do update set updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where batch.workflow_launch_wait.wait_status = 'WAITING' and batch.workflow_launch_wait.workflow_definition_id = excluded.workflow_definition_id and batch.workflow_launch_wait.biz_date = excluded.biz_date and batch.workflow_launch_wait.dry_run = excluded.dry_run
mapper.select: with first_per_slot as ( select distinct on (waiting.workflow_definition_id, waiting.biz_date, waiting.dry_run) waiting.id from batch.workflow_launch_wait waiting join batch.trigger_request request on request.tenant_id = waiting.tenant_id and request.request_id = waiting.request_id where waiting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and waiting.wait_status = 'WAITING' and waiting.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP and (exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_run own_run where own_run.tenant_id = waiting.tenant_id and own_run.trigger_request_id = request.id ) or not exists ( select 1 from batch.workflow_run run where run.tenant_id = waiting.tenant_id and run.workflow_definition_id = waiting.workflow_definition_id and run.biz_date = waiting.biz_date and run.dry_run = waiting.dry_run and run.run_status in ('CREATED', 'RUNNING') )) order by waiting.workflow_definition_id, waiting.biz_date, waiting.dry_run, waiting.created_at, waiting.id ), candidates as ( select waiting.id from batch.workflow_launch_wait waiting join first_per_slot first on first.id = waiting.id where waiting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} order by waiting.created_at, waiting.id limit #{limit} for update of waiting skip locked ) update batch.workflow_launch_wait waiting set next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP from candidates candidate where waiting.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and waiting.id = candidate.id and waiting.wait_status = 'WAITING' and waiting.next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP returning waiting.tenant_id, waiting.request_id, waiting.workflow_definition_id, waiting.biz_date, waiting.dry_run, waiting.launch_payload::text
mapper.update: update batch.workflow_launch_wait set wait_status = #{targetStatus}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and request_id = #{requestId} and wait_status = #{expectedStatus}
